# DesOS boot menu. Generated by boot-theme/generate.py; edit that, not this.
# The list is a fixed 760px column centred on the screen and everything else
# is placed in percentages, so one file serves 1920x1080, 1366x768 and 1024x768
# and still fits the 800x600 a BIOS without display data falls back to. Colours are the DEs-UI instrument palette.
